description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the details screen of a food ordering app. It imports necessary UI components and constants, and constructs a Scaffold with an app bar and body specific to the details view.

classes.name: DetailsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the details screen with a scaffold containing a custom app bar and body.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the DetailsScreen, returning a Scaffold with configured background, app bar, and body.
